headline: Senegal Announces Simultaneous Treasury Bond and Bill Auction
summary: The Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO) announced a simultaneous auction of Treasury bills and bonds for Senegal, scheduled for November 20, 2026.
why: Government debt auctions are essential for sovereign financing and provide benchmarks for local interest rates in the West African Economic and Monetary Union.
